description: Questions a shopper would type about Kirana's store policies. Mix of paraphrases (dense should do well) and exact numbers or terms (BM25 should help).
gold_rule: a chunk is relevant if its text contains `gold_substring` (case-insensitive)
provenance: hand-written together with the seed documents, so the wording is closer to the documents than real shoppers' questions would be. Replace with real chat logs once Phase 1 records them.

cases.query: Can I return a pack of rice after opening it?
cases.gold_substring: Opened packaged staples cannot be returned

cases.query: my bananas came bruised, what can I do
cases.gold_substring: bruised, overripe or short in weight

cases.query: How long do I have to return shampoo?

cases.gold_substring: Frozen food and ice cream | Not returnable

cases.query: Until when can I cancel my order for free?
cases.gold_substring: cancel an order free of charge while its status is **Created**

minimum order for free standard delivery
